dict.string: To read the macros off a photograph of your food. The picture is read on this device and is not sent anywhere.
To save the water, food, weight and workouts you log in Senku to Apple Health. Senku only writes; it never reads your Health data.
To save a record card you chose to share to your photos.
To read the macros off a photograph you have already taken. The picture is read on this device and is not sent anywhere.
